entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return something. Order number is 77-B-451. Just tell me if I can or not.
I can certainly look into that for you. Let me pull up that order... Okay, I see it's for the Apex Pro cycling shoes. To make sure I'm logging this correctly, what specifically is the issue?
They don't work for me. The fit is wrong and they're causing blisters after every ride. I think the placement for the cleats is off too. I just want a refund.
I'm sorry to hear they're causing you discomfort. That's definitely not the experience we want for our riders. Let me just check the delivery date here... I see they were delivered 53 days ago.
And yes, absolutely. Those cycling shoes are well within our 90-day return window. I can process this return for you immediately.

I've just approved the full refund, which will be credited back to your original payment method once we receive the item. A pre-paid return shipping label has been sent to the email on your account. Just print it, attach it to the box, and drop it off.

Also, I see here that you're a VIP member with us, Ms. Evans. As a courtesy for the trouble with the blisters and the fit, I've added a $25 credit to your account for your next VeloFit purchase. Perhaps we can help you find a pair that's a better match.
Oh. All right, thank you for that.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Perfect. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
